method: 5-param DE on paper canonical Gaussian form (1 Gaussian + power-law background), f_H=0.297, T205 OBS_PUBLISHED 8-channel published-σ_unc
interpretation: 5-param DE on the canonical Gaussian form (apples-to-apples with A.1) finds best-fit with 4 of 8 channels PASS, logL = -11.196. Compare to A.1 canonical Phase 44 free fit (1 of 8, logL = -3480). If 4 > 1, the canonical Gaussian form CAN be tuned to satisfy more channels than the A.1 headline 1/8. If 4 = 1, the canonical Gaussian form is fundamentally limited at 1/8 regardless of tuning.
